headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth in Q2 FY27, led by TCS and HCLTech.
summary: TCS reported ₹73,188 cr revenue with a 24% operating margin and strong deal wins. HCLTech posted 3% QoQ revenue growth and highlighted AI sales as a key driver. Several peers have not yet released results, keeping the broader picture incomplete. Overall, the sector showed healthy top‑line expansion and improving margins.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: Both TCS and HCLTech emphasized AI revenue, with TCS reaching $3.1 bn annualized AI revenue and HCLTech reporting a 78% YoY jump in AI sales.

themes.title: Steady deal wins
themes.detail: TCS secured $9.6 bn of new contracts while HCLTech added $3.258 bn, supporting revenue momentum.

leaders.why: Highest revenue and margin; strong deal wins and AI revenue crossing 10% of total.
Strong AI‑driven profit growth and clear FY27 guidance.

laggards.why: Results not yet released, limiting visibility.
